overall_summary: Analysis of 38 shorts reveals that high-performing videos leverage time-bound high-stakes events (e.g., 'for 5 Seconds') and visual sky/celestial transformations, driving top views (up to 1,038) and extreme average percentage watched (up to 361.81%). Videos focusing on abstract outer planet swaps without immediate Earth consequences suffer steep drop-offs (e.g., 21.33% AVP).

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 881 views with 64.26% AVP (39s AVD); 'What If the Sun Blinked Off for 5 Seconds?' achieved 281 views with 72.18% AVP (42s AVD).
what_is_working.action: Include strict time durations in titles and hooks to create immediate urgency and strong curiosity.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' reached 1,038 views with 50.75% AVP; 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' generated 701 views.
what_is_working.action: Focus topics on direct visual alterations to Earth's sky or environment visible from a human perspective.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth's Core Froze Solid for 5 Seconds?' yielded 361.81% AVP (213s AVD on 108 views); 'What If Earth Passed Through Saturn's Rings?' achieved 195.54% AVP.
what_is_working.action: Design dense visual transformations with seamless end-to-beginning audio/visual loops to maximize rewatch loops.

what_to_improve.pattern: Abstract Planet Swaps Lacking Earth Surface Impact
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Jupiter and Saturn Swapped Places?' averaged only 21.33% AVP (12s AVD) with relative retention dropping to 0.06 by 5% video progress.
what_to_improve.action: Re-frame deep-space planetary mechanics around how they directly impact Earth's surface or sky.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Tripled For 5 Seconds?' dropped to 28.24% AVP; 'What If Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet?' achieved only 24.39% AVP.
what_to_improve.action: Show the visual payoff within the first 1-2 seconds of the video alongside the spoken hook.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' was published twice within 15 seconds (04:55:51Z and 04:56:06Z).
what_to_improve.action: Enforce strict publishing workflows to avoid duplicate uploads and spread out releases cleanly.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth's Core Froze Solid for 5 Seconds?' retained an audience watch ratio of 4.5 at 1% progress and maintained 3.55 at 49% progress (361.81% overall AVP).
retention_insights.action: Replicate the precise visual loop structure where the climax resolution seamlessly connects to the initial hook text.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Jupiter and Saturn Swapped Places?' saw relative retention plunge from 0.1964 at 1% progress down to 0.0623 by 6% progress.
retention_insights.action: Eliminate intro logo sequences or text setups; start immediately with high-contrast motion graphics in frame 1.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Saturn's Rings Filled Our Daytime Sky?' dropped to 0.3204 relative retention at 10% progress, but rebounded to 0.4052 relative retention at 49% progress.
retention_insights.action: Move the visual payoff from the middle of the video closer to the 3-5 second mark to capture drop-offs earlier.

best_posting_windows.reason: Publications near 05:00 UTC yielded top view totals including 1,038 views (Saturn Rings), 701 views (Sound in Space), 428 views (Earth-Venus Swap), and 281 views with 72.18% AVP (Sun Blinked Off).
Publications near 12:30 UTC produced 881 views with 64.26% AVP (Atmosphere Lost), 397 views (Asteroid Moon), and the highest rewatch video with 361.81% AVP (Core Froze).

avoid_or_limit.item: Abstract outer-planet-only interactions without Earth context
avoid_or_limit.reason: Videos like 'What If Jupiter and Saturn Swapped Places?' resulted in the channel's lowest retention (21.33% AVP and immediate 94% drop off).
'What If You Could See Every Wi-Fi Signal?' generated low view reach (41 views) compared to planetary scale topics.
Posting identical content seconds apart dilutes early traffic distribution and risks algorithmic penalty.
